- [FACT] The show "Before The Game" aired on the Australian television network Channel Ten from 2010 to 2013.
- [FACT] The hosts of "Before The Game" were Anthony Lehmann, Andrew Maher, and Ryan Fitzgerald.
- [FACT] The show featured a rotating panel of guests, including comedians, former athletes, and sports journalists.
- [CHANGE] In 2012, the show underwent a rebranding, changing its name from "The Footy Panel Show" to "Before The Game."
- [EVENT] The show ended in 2013, marking the end of an era for Friday night sports entertainment on Channel Ten.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cancellation of "Before The Game" was due to changes in the network's sports coverage and the hosts seeking new opportunities.
